gaps.normative_requirement: The standard covers portable electric heating tools within its scope, while exclusively industrial appliances are excluded; a thermoplastic conduit-welding tool uses a fitting with an integral heating wire.
gaps.finding_reason: The report calls the product a plastic tube welding tool but also describes a machine located in a factory. Its intended use and welding method are not sufficiently documented to establish scope or whether the fitting-specific requirements apply.
gaps.required_action: Document intended use and welding method, and establish the applicable product classification and standard scope.

gaps.normative_requirement: The particular part supplements or modifies the corresponding clauses of IEC 60335-1.
gaps.finding_reason: The claimed appliance-standard report contains machine-equipment clauses and an IEC 60204 annex instead of a traceable clause-by-clause appliance assessment; identical clause numbers cannot be treated as evidence of the corresponding appliance tests.
gaps.required_action: Obtain a replacement report using the applicable appliance-standard requirements and product-specific test records.

gaps.normative_requirement: Appliances other than dehorning tools shall be class I, II or III.
gaps.finding_reason: The report’s clause 6.1 concerns machine shock protection and does not identify the tested appliance’s protection class.
gaps.required_action: Record and substantiate the appliance’s protection class.

gaps.normative_requirement: Heating tests are performed away from test-corner walls and, for appliances other than firelighters, continue until steady conditions are established.
gaps.finding_reason: The report’s clause 11 addresses electronic equipment; no appliance heating test, arrangement, steady-state record or temperature results are provided.
gaps.required_action: Perform and document the applicable heating assessment and test conditions.

gaps.normative_requirement: The abnormal-operation tests use the specified clause 11 conditions at 0.94 and 1.06 times rated voltage, subject to the stated exceptions.
gaps.finding_reason: Report clauses 19.2 and 19.3 address protective bonding and insulation resistance, not abnormal operation at the specified voltages.
gaps.required_action: Conduct and document the applicable abnormal-operation tests at both specified voltages.

gaps.normative_requirement: Hand-held appliances are subjected to the specified drop tests from 1 m onto a 50 mm hardwood base.
gaps.finding_reason: The photographed tool is hand-held, but the report provides no drop-test procedure or post-test assessment of damage and access to live parts.
gaps.required_action: Perform and document the hand-held drop tests and post-test examination.

gaps.normative_requirement: Applicable hand-held appliances require a stand unless the specified clause 11 exception applies, and stability testing is performed on their stands.
gaps.finding_reason: The report does not establish the intended working location, stand provision, applicability of the exception or stability-test result.
gaps.required_action: Document the intended use and stand arrangement, and assess construction and stability as applicable.

gaps.normative_requirement: The modified cord-anchorage pull force and torque provisions apply to hand-held appliances.
gaps.finding_reason: The report does not record appliance mass or an appliance cord-anchorage test, so the applicable test parameters and result cannot be verified.
gaps.required_action: Record the appliance mass and perform the applicable cord-anchorage assessment.

gaps.normative_requirement: For appliances other than contact firelighters, clause 30.2.2 of Part 1 applies.
gaps.finding_reason: No appliance heat-and-fire resistance assessment is recorded; the detailed Part 1 requirements are unavailable because that standard was not supplied.
gaps.required_action: Obtain the applicable Part 1 and document the required resistance-to-heat-and-fire assessment.

gaps.normative_requirement: The corresponding Part 1 clauses apply, subject to the particular-part modifications.
gaps.finding_reason: Appliance-specific evidence for access to live parts, power input, leakage current, electric strength, transient overvoltages and moisture resistance is not established by the machine-equipment entries.
gaps.required_action: Obtain US IEC 60335-1:2010 and its applicable amendments, and provide a clause-by-clause appliance assessment with test data.

gaps.normative_requirement: The corresponding Part 1 clauses apply, subject to the particular-part modifications.
gaps.finding_reason: The report does not provide a traceable appliance assessment of wiring, components, supply connection, terminals, earthing, connections, insulation distances, rusting and radiation or similar hazards.
gaps.required_action: Provide the applicable Part 1 and a product-specific assessment of these clauses, including measurements where required.

gaps.normative_requirement: Scope and applicability must be established from the supplied product standard.
gaps.finding_reason: The report states both that no neutral conductor is used and that a neutral is used, leaving the recorded electrical construction inconsistent.
gaps.required_action: Reconcile the neutral-conductor statements against the tested sample and correct the report.

gaps.normative_requirement: The assessment must relate to the product within the stated standard scope.
gaps.finding_reason: Page 3 is identified only as "001" rather than the complete report number, weakening page attribution.
gaps.required_action: Correct page 3 attribution and verify the integrity of the complete report.

final_summary.evaluation_conclusion: Product compliance has not been demonstrated. The recorded 5 MΩ insulation resistance and 1,000 V electric-strength result do not substitute for the missing appliance-standard assessment; no product non-conformity has been established from the supplied evidence.
final_summary.recommended_action: Obtain the applicable general standard and amendments, establish product classification and scope, and provide a replacement appliance-specific report with the necessary test data before certification proceeds.
